rows.static_review_summary: Curl_fopen() derives the temporary file name by appending a random suffix to the full target path (frozen line 71: aprintf("%s.%s.tmp", filename, randsuffix)). When the target file name is long enough that the derived temp name exceeds the file-system NAME_MAX, the temp file cannot be created and the HSTS store rewrite path clears the existing HSTS file, so a later curl invocation trusts HSTS hosts that the store should have pinned (CWE-311). NVD CPE and the curl advisory both place 8.3.0 in 7.84.0 <= v < 8.5.0. The fix (73b65e94, released in 8.5.0) replaces the target-name-derived temp name with a directory prefix plus 40 random characters and ".tmp", via the new dirslash() helper; curl-8_5_0 ships that code and the frozen 8.3.0 tree does not.

rows.static_review_summary: Curl_vsetopt() parses CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS_STR into a local curl_prot_t and assigns data->set.allowed_protocols only when protocol2num() succeeds (frozen lines 2693-2698). protocol2num() returns CURLE_BAD_FUNCTION_ARGUMENT when the parsed mask is empty (frozen lines 183-186), which is exactly the "-all,-http" case, so the caller keeps the default protocol set and the explicitly disabled protocols stay usable (CWE-115/CWE-436 misinterpretation of the option value). NVD CPE and the curl advisory both place 8.3.0 in 7.85.0 <= v < 8.7.0. The fix (17d302e5, released in 8.7.0) passes the destination mask directly to protocol2num() and clears it before parsing, so the empty set survives the error path; curl-8_7_0 ships that code and the frozen 8.3.0 tree does not.

rows.static_review_summary: Curl_gtls_verifyserver() parses the stapled OCSP response only when gnutls_ocsp_status_request_is_checked() returns 0 (frozen line 928); when GnuTLS reports the response as already checked, the else branch at frozen lines 1024-1025 records "server certificate status verification OK" without inspecting the OCSP certificate status, so a response whose status is an error other than revoked (for example unauthorized) is accepted as valid (CWE-295). NVD CPE and the curl advisory both place 8.3.0 in 7.41.0 <= v < 8.10.0. The fix (aeb1a281, released in 8.10.0) drops the is_checked() gate, always imports the response, and returns CURLE_SSL_INVALIDCERTSTATUS unless the status is GOOD; curl-8_10_0 ships that code and the frozen 8.3.0 tree does not.

rows.static_review_summary: on_header() doubles the PUSH_PROMISE header array as headers arrive; once the allocation count exceeds 1000 it frees the array with Curl_safefree() and aborts the push (frozen line 1458). Curl_safefree() frees only the array block, not the up-to-1000 header strings it holds, and push_headers_used keeps its value, so every aborted push leaks its headers and the error is silent (CWE-772). NVD CPE and the curl advisory both place 8.3.0 in 7.44.0 <= v < 8.7.0. The fix (deca8039, released in 8.7.0) adds free_push_headers(), which frees each used string and resets the counter, and calls it on the too-many-headers path, the realloc failure path and stream teardown; curl-8_7_0 ships that code and the frozen 8.3.0 tree does not.
